jobs_results.title: Principal Technology Architect – Backend Engineering
jobs_results.description:
Experience:
15+ years of software engineering experience with strong expertise in backend development, system architecture, and distributed systems.


Education:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.


Location:
Remote


Employment Type:
Full-time


Role Overview:
We are looking for an experienced Technology Architect / Principal Engineer with 15+ years of software engineering experience and strong expertise in backend development, system architecture, and distributed systems.


The ideal candidate will have a strong hands-on background in Node.js and Python, combined with the ability to architect and deliver complex, scalable, highly available software solutions. The role requires someone who can work across the full technology lifecycle—from understanding complex business requirements and designing technical solutions to guiding engineering teams through implementation and delivery.


Key Responsibilities:
Define and own the technical architecture for complex, large-scale applications and platforms.
Design scalable, highly available, secure and high-performance backend systems.
Translate complex business and product requirements into robust technical designs and architecture.
Develop and review architecture diagrams, technical specifications, API designs and data models.
Provide hands-on technical leadership in Node.js and Python development.
Design and implement RESTful APIs, microservices and distributed systems.
Evaluate architectural trade-offs involving scalability, performance, reliability, maintainability and cost.
Lead the design of complex features involving multiple services, systems and integrations.
Identify technical risks and develop appropriate mitigation strategies.
Establish and promote architecture, coding and engineering best practices.
Conduct design and code reviews and ensure adherence to engineering standards.
Mentor senior engineers and technical leads and provide technical direction to development teams.
Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, DevOps, Security and other stakeholders.
Drive modernization of legacy systems and adoption of appropriate technologies and architectural patterns.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex production and performance issues at an architectural level.
Stay current with emerging technologies and assess their applicability to the organization’s technology landscape.
Required Technical Skills:
Backend Development
Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and Python.
Excellent understanding of asynchronous programming, API development and backend architecture.
Strong experience designing REST APIs, microservices and event-driven architectures.
Experience with database design and optimization, including SQL and NoSQL databases.
Architecture & System Design
Proven experience designing large-scale, distributed and highly available systems.
Strong knowledge of microservices architecture, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, caching, messaging/stream processing, API gateways, authentication and authorization, fault tolerance and resiliency, scalability and performance optimization.
Ability to perform end-to-end system design and make appropriate technology and architecture decisions.
Cloud & DevOps
Experience with one or more cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP.
Good understanding of containers and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
Familiarity with CI/CD, observability, logging, monitoring and infrastructure automation.
Leadership & Problem-Solving
15+ years of experience in software engineering, architecture and technical leadership.
Demonstrated ability to own architecture for complex products/features from concept to production.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to simplify complex technical problems.
Ability to balance business requirements, technical feasibility, scalability, time-to-market and long-term maintainability.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience mentoring senior engineers and influencing architecture decisions across multiple teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
Experience working with high-scale consumer, enterprise or SaaS platforms.
Experience with cloud-native architectures.
Exposure to AI/ML-enabled applications or modern data platforms is a plus.
Experience leading architecture initiatives across multiple engineering teams is highly desirable.
Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect rather than a purely managerial architect—someone who can:


Understand the problem design the architecture break it into complex features guide implementation review the code/design ensure the solution scales in production.


They should be equally comfortable whiteboarding a distributed system, writing/reviewing Node.js or Python code, challenging architectural assumptions, and mentoring senior engineers.


Does this look like a good fit?


Please send your resume to:


careers@kognitive.net




Does this look like a good fit?


Please email a resume and cover letter to:


careers@kognitive.net

jobs_results.title: Freelance - Senior Backend Architect
jobs_results.description: About the Role  We are seeking an experienced  Senior Backend Architect  (812 years) to work on a  part-time, on-site  basis with our engineering team in the  medical technology domain .  This role is ideal for a seasoned engineer or architect who wants to contribute strategically to backend design and scalability while mentoring a growing team. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in  Django ,  System Design ,  Microservices ,  AWS ,  Docker/Kubernetes , and optionally  Kafka/ETL , along with strong knowledge of  health-tech compliance frameworks  such as  HIPAA  and  ISO 27001 .  You will play a key role in shaping our backend architecture, ensuring scalability, reliability, and compliance for our  medical monitoring and data processing platforms .  Responsibilities  Backend Architecture:  Design, review, and evolve the backend architecture using  Django  (Class-Based Views, models, services); apply  SOLID principles  and  design patterns  to ensure long-term maintainability and scalability.  System Design & Planning:  Drive architectural discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and propose scalable, fault-tolerant designs for backend systems.  API Development:  Oversee and guide the development of  REST APIs  with robust authentication, versioning, and rate limiting.  Security & Compliance:  Implement and audit secure authentication (JWT, OAuth2), access control, and ensure compliance with  HIPAA  and  ISO 27001  standards.  Database Strategy:  Design optimized schemas using  Django ORM ; ensure  data integrity , manage migrations, and oversee query tuning and indexing strategies.  Business Logic:  Architect and modularize core backend logic  such as  patient monitoring workflows ,  health data analysis ,  device data pipelines , and  alerting systems   into reusable service components.  Testing & CI/CD:  Define and enforce testing standards (Pytest, Django TestCase); ensure CI/CD pipelines enable smooth, validated deployments.  DevOps & Cloud:  Advise and collaborate on deployment pipelines using  Docker ,  GitHub Actions/Jenkins , and  AWS/GCP  infrastructure.  Performance & Scalability:  Identify bottlenecks, drive caching and load balancing strategies, and ensure fault tolerance under scale.  Microservices:  Architect, integrate, and maintain  microservice-based components  for distributed and modular system design.  Technical Leadership:  Review pull requests, provide architectural guidance, mentor junior developers, and contribute actively to  technical planning and long-term product scalability .   Required Skills & Experience  812 years of backend or full-stack development experience.  Strong expertise in  Python (Django / DRF)  and  System Architecture Design .  Proven experience with  Microservices  and  Scalable Distributed Systems .  Hands-on experience with  AWS  (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudWatch).  Proficiency in  Docker ,  Kubernetes , and  CI/CD pipelines  (GitHub Actions / Jenkins).  Familiarity with  Kafka ,  ETL pipelines , or event-driven architectures.  Understanding of  HIPAA ,  ISO 27001 , and healthcare data compliance principles.  Excellent leadership, documentation, and communication skills.   Preferred (Nice to Have)  Experience with  Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or Loki  for observability.  Exposure to  IoT-based healthcare devices  or  real-time medical data systems .   Prior experience in  startups or health-tech platforms  dealing with large-scale medical data.

jobs_results.title: Fullstack Backend Architect
jobs_results.description:
About Noon
We are on a mission to reinvent how designers work in the AI era. We’re backed by top investors including First Round, Chemistry, Homebrew, Scribble and senior leaders from OpenAI, Meta, Google, Ramp, Stripe and more. We’re building the next-generation AI design tool for product teams.


We’re hiring a Backend Architect to own the backend that powers a collaborative, real-time canvas used by design teams. You’ll architect the API surface, data layer, and real-time sync that everything else in the product builds on — including every AI feature. This is a deeply hands-on architect role: you’ll design the system and write the code, not just draw boxes.


Our backend is TypeScript end-to-end, multi-tenant, and serves a live multi-user canvas. You’ll set the patterns the rest of the team builds against.


What You’ll DoWork with AI Lead, and own parts of the backend architecture. API design, data modeling, service boundaries, real-time sync, auth and multi-tenancy. Make the calls that everyone else’s code lives inside


Build the real-time and multiplayer layer. WebSocket fanout, presence, conflict resolution, document sync — the substrate that makes the canvas feel live for every user in a workspace


Design the data layer with judgment, not defaults. Pick the right store for each workload — relational, document, event log, blob, cache — and own the schemas, migrations, and consistency model


Ship into our TypeScript monorepo. API, auth, database, and real-time services all live in one codebase — you’ll work across all of them and set the patterns for how they fit together


Own auth, orgs, and permissions. Workspaces, sharing, roles, audit — the things that make us safe to use inside a company


Build AI-friendly backend primitives. Streaming endpoints, long-running agent calls, idempotency, cost attribution — the AI features will call into your APIs and you’ll make sure they can


Set the technical bar for backend engineers. Code review, design review, and the patterns the rest of the backend team learns from


Must-Have Requirements12+ years software engineering experience, with significant time as a hands-on backend architect or senior backend engineer. This is a deeply hands-on role — you’ll write the code, not just review it


Production TypeScript experience in large, complex codebases — you’ve shipped non-trivial backend systems in TS, ideally in a monorepo, and have strong opinions on how to structure a TS backend at scale


Shipped a collaborative or real-time backend in production. WebSocket fanout, presence, document sync, conflict resolution (CRDT, OT, or equivalent) — you’ve owned this in a live multi-user product


Strong database fundamentals. Schema design, indexing, query performance, transactions, migrations, consistency models. Comfortable making the call between relational, document, and event-sourced approaches based on the workload


Multi-tenancy and auth depth — orgs, workspaces, RBAC, sharing semantics, audit


Comfortable with the infra surface — Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD — enough to debug, contribute, and design with infra constraints in mind. You don’t have to own it, but you can’t be helpless around it


Architect-level judgment without manager scope. You’re the technical anchor, not a people manager


Nice to HaveExperience designing AI-aware backend APIs — streaming responses, long-running agent calls, token-bounded request/response shapes, idempotency for retried LLM ops, cost attribution per tenant


CRDT or OT internals experience — Yjs, Automerge, ShareJS lineage, or having built your own


Background shipping canvas, design-tool, IDE, or collaborative-document backends


Experience with observability and reliability engineering at a serious level — SLOs, on-call, debugging production at scale


What You’ll OwnThe backend architecture and the patterns it enforces The real-time / multiplayer layer the canvas depends on The data layer — schemas, stores, migrations, consistency


Auth, multi-tenancy, and permissions The backend primitives every AI feature calls into The technical bar for backend code in the monorepo

Design and implement scalable, secure, and high-performance backend architectures. Lead teams in developing microservices, APIs, and integrations using Java/Spring Boot, ensuring performance, reliability, and cloud readiness.  

Required Candidate profile

Backend architect with solid Java/Spring Boot expertise, experience in microservices, API development, and cloud-native deployment. Skilled in CI/CD and distributed system design.
